## CredentialService.processProposal() method

Process a received [ProposeCredentialMessage](./core.proposecredentialmessage.md). This will not accept the credential proposal or send a credential offer. It will only create a new, or update the existing credential record with the information from the credential proposal message. Use after calling this method to create a credential offer.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processProposal(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<ProposeCredentialMessage>): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter      | Type                                                                                                                           | Description                                                  |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| messageContext | [InboundMessageContext](./core.inboundmessagecontext.md)&lt;[ProposeCredentialMessage](./core.proposecredentialmessage.md)&gt; | The message context containing a credential proposal message |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[CredentialRecord](./core.credentialrecord.md)&gt;

credential record associated with the credential proposal message
